name: scout
description: The discovery loop: inventory every product already built on Plenipo, map industry coverage, and rank unclaimed verticals by how well the platform's spine (chat-first, RBAC-before-the-model, approvals, audit, multi-tenancy, documents, RAG, connectors, channels) fits them — ending in a go/no-go opportunity brief. Enable when choosing what to build next; disable once a vertical is picked.
